summary: Cronos Group Inc., through wholly owned CGM B.V., closed its acquisition of CanAdelaar B.V., a licensed Dutch cannabis grower in the Controlled Cannabis Supply Chain Experiment, from Ring International Holding AG and Landewyck Tobacco S.A. on October 15, 2026, under an addendum to the December 9, 2025 share purchase agreement. Dutch BidCo waived all closing conditions even though a final Bibob background-check decision from the Minister of Health remained outstanding. The board unanimously approved the addendum. A proposed €12.5 million DCMR odor-nuisance penalty was treated as indebtedness and deducted from the estimated initial purchase price, subject to true-up. Watch regulatory approval risk and penalty resolution.
